PRESTO

Accelerate Bench task · Transport, plasma & astronomy

PRESTO searches for pulsars in a time series.

Task version2.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The workflow transforms a dedispersed signal containing an injected pulsar, searches for accelerated candidates, folds a candidate and renders its diagnostic plot.

Correctness

The spectrum, candidate files, folding products and rendered output are compared with the unmodified workflow, with an allowance for record padding.

Timing

Timing includes the Fourier transform, acceleration search, folding and plot rendering.
